title: kbmon sprint panel: every sprint with its items' states, waiting gates and landings in progress
goal: the sprint panel of kbmon.py shows every sprint of the backlog with its state (active, approved or planned), its items' counts by status, its next item and its waiting gates, read through backlog.py's own readers; it shows each landing in progress, an item whose newest land.step row has no later land.end, with its last step

clauses.clause: the sprint panel of kbmon.py shows every sprint of the backlog with its state (active, approved or planned), its items' counts by status, its next item and its waiting gates, read through backlog.py's own readers
it shows each landing in progress, an item whose newest land.step row has no later land.end, with its last step

options: every sprint with its state: active first, then approved, then planned

gates.question: Does the sprint panel list a landing whose newest land.step is old and has no land.end?
options: yes, every one, newest first: the goal names no age limit
only those younger than a limit

gates.answer: yes, every one, newest first: the goal names no age limit

notes: Plan 2026-10-18: backlog.py's readers (bl_view, bl_base.Backlog) are imported, not changed: every bl_ module is an agents-rule path. Data: sprints [{id, state, items {status: n}, next, waiting [{item, gate}]}], landings [{item, step, since}]. No outside facts: the backlog and its ops rows are the kb's own. Layout of the sprint panel (operator's spec): one row per sprint: id, state padded to 10 (active in green), then `4/11 done · next ST-… · counts by status`, or `not started`, or `waits on start gate`; then `landing` rows: item, step, since.
